# get_isotherm_df_for_raspa_folder { #mofography.raspa_helper.get_isotherm_df_for_raspa_folder }

```python
raspa_helper.get_isotherm_df_for_raspa_folder(path_to_folder)
```

Parse RASPA output *.data files in a folder into a sorted isotherm DataFrame.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type   | Description                                              | Default    |
|----------------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| path_to_folder |        | the path to the folder containing the raspa output files | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                         |
|--------|--------|-------------------------------------|
|        |        | A dictionary with the isotherm data |
